input_file.description: Path to the input MIME encoded file. Use '-' for STDIN.

output_dir.description: Output directory where extracted attachments will be saved.

prefix.description: Prefix filename to be used on files without a filename.

header_file.description: Filename for the dumped headers file.

quiet.description: Run quietly, do not report non-fatal errors.

log_destination.description: Output log destination: stdout, stderr, or syslog.

paranoid.description: Converts all filenames to strict 7-bit compliance.

name_by_type.description: Saves a given attachment by its content-type if it has no other name.

overwrite.description: Overwrite files if they have the same name on extraction.

recursion_max.description: Set the maximum recursion level into a mailpack.

extended_errors.description: Returns error codes for non-fatal decoding situations.

debug.description: Produces detailed information about the whole decoding process.

no_uudecode.description: Turns off the facility of detecting UUencoded attachments in emails.

no_quotedprintable.description: Turns off the facility of decoding QuotedPrintable data.

no_doublecr.description: Turns off saving of double-CR embedded data.

no_mht.description: Turns off MHT (a Microsoft mailpack attachment format) decoding.

disable_header_fix.description: Turns off attempts to fix broken headers.

disable_qmail_bounce.description: Turns off look-ahead searching for RFC822 headers within a body of text.

no_multiple_filename.description: Turns off handling multiple filename occurrences in a single MIME header.

verbose_contenttype.description: Turn on verbosity of file content type.

verbose_oldstyle.description: Uses the v1.2.x style or filename reporting.

verbose_defects.description: Report MIME header/body defects located in the mailpack.

unique_names_strategy.description: Unique names strategy: prefix, postfix, or infix.
